name: OriginationCreditSplitter
tagline: Origination, responsible and working credit splits per matter – with policy checks and two-stage approvals.
description: A complete partner credit allocation app for law, accounting and consulting firms: split credit per matter and credit type, enforce 100 % totals, minimum shares and maximum holders, route splits through stage-1 and final approval above a fee threshold, prevent self-approval, handle disputes and see credit per partner.
features: Credit policy checks (100 % totals, minimum share, maximum holders)
Two-stage approval above a fee threshold
Split editor with split evenly and balance last line
Bulk approve, submit and effective date
Demo mode with fictional firm data
